from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f388bb04.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[0 if value == background else background for value in row] for row in grid]
'''
p.write_text(source)
# Execute the saved program and verify on the demo pair.
ns = {}
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), ns)
demo = [[3]*28 for _ in range(28)]
demo_coords = [(3,16),(3,19),(5,26),(14,24),(16,25),(22,15)]
for r,c in demo_coords: demo[r][c] = 5
demo_out = ns['transform'](demo)
expected = [[0]*28 for _ in range(28)]
for r,c in demo_coords: expected[r][c] = 3
assert demo_out == expected
print('saved:', p, 'demo reproduced:', demo_out == expected)
